duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةٌ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wajalnaa muslimaini laka wa min zurriyyatinaaa ummatam muslimatal laka wa arinaa manasikanaa wa tub 'alainaa innaka antat Tawwaabur Raheem
duas.translation: Our Lord! make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

duas.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Laa yukalliful-loahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat: Rabbanaa laa tu aakhiznada in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa, Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-alainaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa: Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammiinaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa a'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
duas.translation: On no soul doth Allah place a burden greater than it can bear. It gets every good that it earns, and it suffers every ill that it earns. (Pray:) 'Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which Thou didst lay on those before us; our Lord! Lay not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Blot out our sins, and grant us forgiveness. Have mercy on us. Thou art our Protector; help us against those who stand against faith.'

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ; رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ; إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da iz hadaltanaa wa hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmaths innaka antal Wahhaab; Rabbanaa innaka jaami un-naasi li Yawmin laa raiba feeh; innal laaha laa yukhilful mee'aad
duas.translation: Our Lord! let not our hearts deviate after Thou hast guided us, and grant us mercy from Thy presence, for Thou art the Grantor of bounties. Our Lord! Thou art He that will gather mankind together against a Day about which there is no doubt. Surely Allah never fails in His promise.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanas rif annaa azaaba Jahannama inna azaabuha kaana gharaamaa innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaarnaa
duas.translation: Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed a grievous affliction. Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

duas.arabic: رَبُّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa zalamnagha anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have wronged our own selves; if Thou forgive us not and bestow not upon us Thy Mercy, we shall certainly be lost.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen
duas.translation: O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy, for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tajalnaa fitnatan lillazeena kafaroo waghfir lanaa Rabbanaa innaka antal Azeezul Hakeem
duas.translation: Our Lord! Make us not a (test and) trial for the Unbelievers, but forgive us, our Lord! for Thou art the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

duas.arabic: رَبُّنَا ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatina mil ladunka rahmatanw wa hayyi langa min amringa rashadaa
duas.translation: Our Lord! bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, and dispose of our affair for us in the right way!
